notes.title: Hollowhead's VR Time Machine Breaks Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hello fellow VR adventurers! We've been very delighted by the warm and enthusiastic response we've received by users and fans of Dinosaur Safari VR.

We've decided to expand on the idea by making a VR experience centered around the idea of a Time Machine. With this new VR experience not only will you be able to visit Dinosaurs, but you will also be able to visit other periods of time in Earth's history. The first volume of this experience will focus on the history of life on Earth, with volumes 2 and 3 to be stretch goals which will focus on Human Evolution and Recorded Human History. To fund the creation of this new VR experience we have launched a Kickstarter campaign. The Kickstarter project URL can be found here:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hollowhead/hollowheads-virtual-reality-time-machine-breaks-kickstarter/

We have included significant early-bird discounts of up to 50% for most reward levels so act fast if you'd like to join us on this new adventure.

Contact us if you have any questions. 

Thank you!

- Jason Holloway
